descriptionText:
2026 Topps Series 1 - Titans of the Game insert lot of 3 cards.

Juan Soto - New York Mets - #TOG-11
Julio Rodriguez - Seattle Mariners - #TOG-20
Elly De La Cruz - Cincinnati Reds - #TOG-5

All three from the Titans of the Game insert set, with the rainbow foil baseball background design. Ungraded, near mint or better. Every card is pictured front and back.

You will receive the exact three cards pictured. Shipped in sleeves and a toploader, protected.
